PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride

Portage, MI

LGBTQ+Beginner friendly

PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride is a social group ride in Portage, MI. It meets every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, through mid-September, starting at Water Street Coffee (Portage). Expect about 8–12 miles, party pace.

About the PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride group ride

A social, casual ride on paved trails hosted by the PEDAL bike shop. Everyone welcome, all bikes including e-bikes. Party pace, 8 to 12 miles. Last ride of 2026 was September 15.
